items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock Worth Investigating and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: CAH Q2 CY2026 Deep Dive: Specialty Momentum, Strategic Investments, and Guidance Above Street Expectations
items.summary: Healthcare distributor and services company Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 5.8% year on year to $63.67 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.60 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
